cards.example_en: Please leave a message if I miss your call.
cards.example_zh: 如果我没接到你的电话，请留言。
cards.explain_zh: message是可数名词；information通常不可数。

cards.example_en: Please leave a message if I miss your call.
cards.example_zh: 如果我没接到你的电话，请留言。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Some fruits freeze well; berries, for instance, keep their flavour.
cards.example_zh: 有些水果适合冷冻，比如浆果就能保留风味。
cards.explain_zh: for instance意为“例如”，作用类似for example。

cards.example_en: Some fruits freeze well; berries, for instance, keep their flavour.
cards.example_zh: 有些水果适合冷冻，比如浆果就能保留风味。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Her colourful paintings have a cheerful, playful style.
cards.example_zh: 她色彩丰富的画作有一种欢快、俏皮的风格。
cards.explain_zh: style可指个人风格，不一定表示流行时尚。

cards.example_en: Please refer to the map inside your guidebook.
cards.example_zh: 请查阅你的旅行指南里的地图。
cards.explain_zh: 常接to；过去式referred，分词referring。

cards.example_en: My hands were cold, so I put on gloves.
cards.example_zh: 我的手很冷，于是戴上了手套。
cards.explain_zh: “觉得冷”用be cold；“感冒了”用have a cold。

cards.example_en: Cold weather can increase household energy costs, placing additional pressure on families with limited incomes.
cards.example_zh: 寒冷天气会增加家庭能源开支，给收入有限的家庭带来额外压力。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Could you push the trolley while I carry these bags?
cards.example_zh: 我来拿这些袋子，你能推一下手推车吗？
cards.explain_zh: push表示推，pull表示拉；push for意为力争。

cards.example_en: Almost a quarter of the city's residents depend on public transport for their daily commute.
cards.example_zh: 这座城市近四分之一的居民依靠公共交通日常通勤。
cards.explain_zh: a quarter of an hour是一刻钟；季度也是quarter。

cards.example_en: Almost a quarter of the city's residents depend on public transport for their daily commute.
cards.example_zh: 这座城市近四分之一的居民依靠公共交通日常通勤。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Don't assume the shop is open on Sundays.
cards.example_zh: 别想当然地以为这家店周日营业。
cards.explain_zh: assume常接that从句，强调未经证实便认为。

cards.example_en: Policymakers should not assume that all households have reliable internet access or adequate digital skills.
cards.example_zh: 政策制定者不应假定所有家庭都有稳定的网络连接或足够的数字技能。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The baby fell asleep while her father sang softly.
cards.example_zh: 爸爸轻声唱歌时，宝宝睡着了。
cards.explain_zh: 复数为babies；baby作动词常含“过度照顾”之意。

cards.example_en: Our first attempt at baking bread was surprisingly successful.
cards.example_zh: 我们第一次尝试烤面包，出乎意料地成功了。
cards.explain_zh: 常用be successful in doing；动词为succeed。

cards.example_en: We sing our favourite songs while washing the dishes.
cards.example_zh: 我们一边洗碗，一边唱自己最喜欢的歌。
cards.explain_zh: 不规则变化：sing—sang—sung。

cards.example_en: I doubt the shop is still open this late.
cards.example_zh: 这么晚了，我觉得那家店大概已经关门了。
cards.explain_zh: b不发音；I doubt that常表示认为某事不大可能。

cards.example_en: Our school is holding a painting competition next Friday.
cards.example_zh: 我们学校下周五要举办绘画比赛。
cards.explain_zh: 表示竞争通常不可数；表示一场比赛时可数。

cards.example_en: My theory is that the cat knocked the cup over.
cards.example_zh: 我猜是猫把杯子碰倒了。
cards.explain_zh: in theory意为“理论上”，常与in practice对比。

cards.example_en: Researchers propose expanding urban green spaces to improve air quality and encourage residents to exercise more regularly.
cards.example_zh: 研究人员提议扩大城市绿地，以改善空气质量并鼓励居民更经常地锻炼。
cards.explain_zh: propose doing是提议；propose to do通常是打算。

cards.example_en: Her speech included a warm reference to her grandmother.
cards.example_zh: 她在演讲中温情地提到了祖母。
cards.explain_zh: reference to表示提及；for reference表示供参考。

cards.example_en: We had an argument about whose turn it was.
cards.example_zh: 我们为该轮到谁而争吵了起来。
cards.explain_zh: 争吵常接with或about；支持某观点用argument for。

cards.example_en: Children must visit the swimming pool with an adult.
cards.example_zh: 儿童必须由成年人陪同前往游泳池。
cards.explain_zh: 既可作可数名词，也可作形容词，如adult education。

cards.example_en: Adult education programmes help people gain new qualifications and adapt to changes in the labour market.
cards.example_zh: 成人教育项目帮助人们获得新的资格，并适应劳动力市场的变化。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Small birds fly over our garden every morning.
cards.example_zh: 每天早晨都有小鸟飞过我们的花园。
cards.explain_zh: 动词变化fly–flew–flown；苍蝇复数为flies。

cards.example_en: Please save the document before you close your laptop.
cards.example_zh: 合上笔记本电脑之前，请保存文档。
cards.explain_zh: 动词末尾读/ment/，名词末尾读/mənt/。

cards.example_en: Researchers should document changes in local wildlife to assess the environmental impact of urban development.
cards.example_zh: 研究人员应记录当地野生生物的变化，以评估城市开发对环境的影响。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My cat follows the same sleeping pattern every day.
cards.example_zh: 我的猫每天都遵循相同的睡眠规律。
cards.explain_zh: 表示规律常用a pattern of＋名词。

cards.example_en: I sent my job application before breakfast this morning.
cards.example_zh: 今天早饭前，我提交了求职申请。
cards.explain_zh: 申请某物用application for，向机构申请用to。

cards.example_en: Be careful; the soup is still very hot.
cards.example_zh: 小心，汤还很烫。
cards.explain_zh: 形容食物时可指“烫”或“辣”，需结合语境。

cards.example_en: The puppy was obviously tired after its long walk.
cards.example_zh: 走了很长一段路后，小狗显然累了。
cards.explain_zh: 表示情况显而易见；讨论争议观点时慎用，以免武断。

cards.example_en: Repeated delays and unclear explanations can madden commuters who depend on reliable public transport.
cards.example_zh: 反复延误和含糊的解释会让依赖可靠公共交通的通勤者极为恼火。
cards.source: Word Atlas context; product gloss correction

cards.example_en: We asked for the bill after finishing our lunch.
cards.example_zh: 吃完午饭后，我们请服务员拿来账单。
cards.explain_zh: bill是待审议的法案；通过并生效后才成为法律。

cards.example_en: The search for my lost keys took the whole evening.
cards.example_zh: 寻找丢失的钥匙花了整整一个晚上。

cards.example_en: We keep clean towels in a separate cupboard.
cards.example_zh: 我们把干净毛巾放在一个单独的柜子里。
cards.explain_zh: 形容词词尾读/ət/，动词词尾读/eɪt/。

cards.example_en: Our apartment is central, so we walk to most places.
cards.example_zh: 我们的公寓位于市中心，因此去大多数地方都步行。
cards.explain_zh: central to表示“对……至关重要”，介词用to。

cards.example_en: Access to reliable information is central to helping citizens make informed decisions about public health.
cards.example_zh: 获取可靠信息对于帮助公民就公共卫生作出明智决定至关重要。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My sister hopes to build a career in nursing.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐希望在护理行业发展事业。
cards.explain_zh: career侧重长期职业发展，job指具体工作。

cards.example_en: It started raining, but we went for a walk anyway.
cards.example_zh: 虽然开始下雨了，但我们还是去散步了。
cards.explain_zh: anyway是副词；any way指任何方式。

cards.example_en: Leila practised her speech in front of the mirror.
cards.example_zh: 莱拉对着镜子练习演讲。
cards.explain_zh: 一次演讲用a speech；说话能力通常不可数。

cards.example_en: Our dog waits by the door every afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 我们的狗每天下午都守在门边。
cards.explain_zh: 动词常见被动式be dogged by，表示长期受困扰。

cards.example_en: Training a guide dog requires considerable time, but it can greatly improve someone's independence.
cards.example_zh: 训练一只导盲犬需要大量时间，但它能显著增强使用者的独立生活能力。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A police officer helped us find the station.
cards.example_zh: 一位警察帮我们找到了车站。
cards.explain_zh: officer可指警察或军官，具体含义看搭配。

cards.example_en: A police officer helped us find the station.
cards.example_zh: 一位警察帮我们找到了车站。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The smell of fresh bread spread throughout the house.
cards.example_zh: 新鲜面包的香味飘满了整栋房子。
cards.explain_zh: throughout强调整个范围或全程，不只是某一点。

cards.example_en: The truck carried oil from the well to the refinery.
cards.example_zh: 卡车把原油从油井运往炼油厂。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；表示不同种类的油时可用oils。

cards.example_en: She wore a blue dress to her sister's party.
cards.example_zh: 她穿了一条蓝色连衣裙去参加姐姐的聚会。
cards.explain_zh: a dress指连衣裙；get dressed指穿好衣服。

cards.example_en: The bakery made a small profit this month.
cards.example_zh: 这家面包店这个月赚了一点钱。
cards.explain_zh: profit是扣除成本后的利润，不等于收入revenue。

cards.example_en: Can you guess what is inside this little box?
cards.example_zh: 你能猜出这个小盒子里装着什么吗？
cards.explain_zh: I guess偏口语，表示“我想、大概”，语气不确定。

cards.example_en: We had so much fun building sandcastles together yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天我们一起堆沙堡，玩得特别开心。
cards.explain_zh: fun作名词不可数；funny多指好笑的或奇怪的。

word.example_en: A local housing officer can advise residents on applying for affordable accommodation and accessing financial support.
word.example_zh: 当地住房事务官员可以指导居民申请可负担住房并获取经济援助。
word.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
